name: Teikoku Corporation
summary: Teikoku Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of electrical and general machinery and equipment. The company provides canned motor pumps; metering pumps; canned motor agitators; electric oil pumps; protection devices for canned motor pumps; high temperature molten salt circulation pumps; sealless gas blower for SF6 gas; rotating direction indicator for motors; and roll stabilizer motors, as well as spare parts. It also offers inspection, on-site and in-house repair, and maintenance services, as well as after-sales services.
